verdict.rationale: Orb documents revenue-recognition exports "for financial systems" and managed daily exports to a data destination. That is a thin, first-party path for getting recognized and deferred revenue out to finance tooling, but the evidence never names a GL or ERP connector or shows a direct sync of invoices and payments. Missing for 10: named QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite integrations, documented sync of invoices and payments into a GL/ERP, journal-entry or account mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery

citations.quote: Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
